paragraphs.text: You will need to fill in an application for a passport in the following circumstances: if you are applying for a passport for the first time, if you wish to replace your current passport, if your passport has expired, or if it has been lost or stolen. Your application form must be completed in your own handwriting.
paragraphs.translation:
在以下情况下，您需要填写护照申请表：如果您是首次申请护照、希望更换现有护照、护照已过期，或者护照丢失或被盗。

paragraphs.text: As proof of your citizenship and identity, you must enclose either your passport or your birth certificate. All documents must be originals; these will be returned with your passport.
paragraphs.translation:

所有文件必须是原件；这些文件将与您的护照一同返还。

paragraphs.text: The standard time to process an application is up to 10 working days.The processing begins from when we have received the completed application form. paragraphs.text: Planning a gap year
paragraphs.translation: 规划你的间隔年

paragraphs.text: The best reason to take a gap year between school and work or higher education is to improve your CV with experience overseas. This is why some school leavers in Britain now consider a year out to be essential. Many want to travel, with Sydney the favourite destination. Shooting Star is an organisation that helps school leavers by offering training followed by appropriate employment.
paragraphs.translation:
在学业与工作或高等教育之间休间隔年的最佳理由是通过海外经历来丰富你的简历。
这就是为什么英国一些中学毕业生现在认为休一年学是必不可少的。
许多人想要旅行，其中悉尼是最受欢迎的目的地。
‘流星’是一个帮助中学毕业生的组织，它提供培训并随后安排合适的工作。

paragraphs.text: We at Shooting Star offer much more than a trip abroad. At Shooting Star you acquire skills that lead to interesting jobs both for your gap year and future holidays. Magazines are full of 'Wanted' adverts for washing up in a restaurant. Well, we don't do that- it's not our idea of excitement. We offer school leavers the chance for outdoor adventure, to teach things like sailing and snowboarding. No choice, really! In your year out you train, travel and work; you can combine work with pleasure and reap the rewards. You could become an experienced yacht skipper or instructor and many people go on to spend their future holidays being paid to enjoy their favourite sport.
paragraphs.translation:
我们 Shooting Star 提供的远不止一次出国旅行。
在 Shooting Star，你能够获得技能，这些技能会为你带来在间隔年以及未来假期中从事有趣工作的机会。
杂志上满是招聘餐厅洗碗工的‘诚聘’广告。
嗯，我们不会那样做——这并非我们心目中的兴奋点。
我们为离校生提供户外探险的机会，教授诸如帆船和滑雪等技能。
真的别无选择！
在间隔年里，你会接受培训、旅行和工作；你可以将工作与乐趣相结合，并从中获得回报。
你可能会成为一名经验丰富的游艇船长或教练，而许多人随后会在未来的假期中，通过享受他们最喜爱的运动来获得报酬。

paragraphs.text: Australians and New Zealanders travel to Europe and North America in large numbers to gain overseas experience. Those who qualify with Shooting Star are very soon using their skills in jobs they could only dream about before, working outdoors and seeing more of the world. Wherever you come from, a gap year with Shooting Star means professional training and international adventure.
paragraphs.translation:
大量澳大利亚人和新西兰人前往欧洲和北美以获取海外经历。
那些获得Shooting Star资格的人很快就能在他们以前只能梦想的工作中运用技能，在户外工作并见识更广阔的世界。
无论你来自哪里，与Shooting Star一起度过的间隔年意味着专业培训和国际冒险。

paragraphs.text: Top tips for a successful gap year:
paragraphs.translation: 成功间隔年的顶级建议：

paragraphs.text: ☆ Design your gap year in outline before applying for a permanent job or a college place. Human Resources officers or Admissions tutors will be impressed by a thought-out plan.
paragraphs.translation:
☆ 在申请永久职位或大学入学之前，先大致规划你的间隔年。
人力资源官员或招生导师会对一个经过深思熟虑的计划印象深刻。

paragraphs.text: ☆ What's more important to you - travel or work experience? You can be flexible with travel plans but you must research job opportunities in advance. Go to our website and click on Recruitment for ideas.
paragraphs.translation:
☆ 对你来说，什么更重要——旅行还是工作经历？
你可以在旅行计划上灵活安排，但必须提前研究工作机会。
访问我们的网站，点击“招聘”栏目获取想法。

paragraphs.text: ☆ Who do you know who has taken a gap year before? Shooting Star can put you in touch with someone who has just completed one.
paragraphs.translation:
☆ 你认识谁曾经度过间隔年吗？
“流星”机构可以帮你联系一位刚刚完成间隔年的人。

paragraphs.text: ☆ Sort out the admin in plenty of time - air tickets, visas, insurance and medical matters such as vaccinations for some destinations. These are your responsibility.
paragraphs.translation:
提前处理好行政事务——包括机票、签证、保险以及针对某些目的地所需的疫苗接种等医疗事项。
这些是你的责任。

paragraphs.text: ☆ Who is in charge of your affairs while you are away? There will be forms to fill and letters to answer.
paragraphs.translation:
☆ 当你不在的时候，谁负责处理你的事务？
会有表格需要填写，信件需要回复。

paragraphs.text: ☆ Allow plenty of time to settle back home on your return - and don't be surprised if it takes some time to readjust to everyday life!
paragraphs.translation: √ 请在回国后留出充足的时间让自己重新适应家庭生活——如果花一些时间才能重新适应日常生活，不必感到惊讶！

paragraphs.text: Succeeding at Interviews
paragraphs.translation: 面试中的成功之道

paragraphs.text: A

Getting invited to an interview means you have passed the first hurdle - your application must have made a good impression. Now you need to prepare yourself for the interview to make sure you make the most of this opportunity. There are a number of things you can do.
paragraphs.translation:
获得面试邀请意味着你已经通过了第一道难关——你的申请一定给人留下了良好的印象。
现在你需要为面试做好准备，以确保你充分利用这一机会。
你可以做许多事情来为此做准备。

paragraphs.text: B

Firstly you can do some research. Find out about the employer and the job, ask for an information pack or speak to people you know who work for the company. Try to plan for the interview by asking who will be interviewing you and whether there will be a test to take.
paragraphs.translation:
首先，你可以做一些调研。
了解雇主和职位信息，索取相关资料包，或与你认识的公司员工交流。
尝试为面试做计划，询问谁将面试你以及是否有测试需要参加。

paragraphs.text: C

Prepare for questions you might be asked. Some common ones are the reason why you want the job, whether you have done this kind of work before, what your strengths and weaknesses are, and which leisure pursuits you enjoy.
paragraphs.translation:
准备好你可能被问到的问题。
一些常见问题包括：你为什么想要这份工作，是否做过类似工作，你的优点和缺点是什么，以及你有哪些业余爱好。

paragraphs.text: D

Another important point is never to run the risk of arriving late. For example, consider making a 'dummy run in advance to see how long the journey will take. Check out public transport or, if you are going by car, the nearest parking. Aim to arrive about 10 minutes before the interview is due to start.
paragraphs.translation:
另一个重要的一点是，永远不要冒险迟到。
例如，考虑提前进行一次模拟行程，以了解路途所需时间。
查一下公共交通，或者如果你开车去，要找到最近的停车场。
尽量在面试预定开始时间前大约10分钟到达。

paragraphs.text: E

It is also crucial to give plenty of thought to what you are going to wear. This will depend on the job you are going for. There is no need to buy a new outfit, but aim to look neat and tidy. Remember, if you look good it will help you feel good.
paragraphs.translation:
同样关键的是，要充分考虑你要穿什么。
这将取决于你应聘的工作。
没有必要购买新套装，但务求看起来整洁得体。
记住，如果你看起来不错，这会有助于你感觉良好。

paragraphs.text: F

You need to make a good impression. Interviews can vary from a relatively informal 'one-to-one' chat to a very formal panel situation. Whatever the circumstances, you will give yourself an advantage by being friendly and polite, by making eye contact with the interviewer and by selling yourself by focusing on your strengths.
paragraphs.translation:
你需要留下一个好印象。
面试可能从相对非正式的“一对一”聊天，到非常正式的评审团面试，形式各不相同。
无论在何种情况下，保持友好礼貌、与面试官进行眼神交流，并通过突出自身优势来推销自己，都会让你占据优势。

paragraphs.text: G

There are also things you should avoid doing at your interview. First of all, don’t exaggerate. For example, if you don’t have the exact experience the employer is looking for, say so and explain you are willing to learn. Don’t simply give ‘yes’ and ‘no’ answers, but answer questions as fully as you can. And lastly don’t forget to ask questions as well as answering them.
paragraphs.translation:
在面试中也有一些你应该避免做的事情。
首先，不要夸大其词。
例如，如果你没有雇主正在寻找的特定经验，就如实说明并解释你愿意学习。
不要仅仅给出‘是’或‘不是’的回答，而要尽可能完整地回答问题。
最后，不要忘了在回答问题的同时也提出问题。
在面试中，你还需要避免做一些事情。
例如，如果你不具备雇主所要求的确切经验，就如实说明，并解释你愿意学习。
不要只给出‘是’或‘不是’的回答，而是尽可能全面地回答问题。
最后，别忘了在回答问题的同时，也要提出问题。

paragraphs.text: H

One final thing to remember: it is important to show good team spirit, that you possess good people skills and that you are friendly and approachable. Finally, remember to be enthusiastic and show that you can be flexible.
paragraphs.translation:
最后一点要记住：展现出良好的团队精神、拥有出色的人际交往能力，以及为人友善且平易近人，这一点非常重要。
最后，请记住要保持热情，并展现出你可以灵活变通。

sentence_translations.sentence: Planning a gap year
sentence_translations.translation: 规划你的间隔年

sentence_translations.sentence: The best reason to take a gap year between school and work or higher education is to improve your CV with experience overseas.
sentence_translations.translation: 在学业与工作或高等教育之间休间隔年的最佳理由是通过海外经历来丰富你的简历。

sentence_translations.sentence: This is why some school leavers in Britain now consider a year out to be essential.
sentence_translations.translation: 这就是为什么英国一些中学毕业生现在认为休一年学是必不可少的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Many want to travel, with Sydney the favourite destination.
sentence_translations.translation: 许多人想要旅行，其中悉尼是最受欢迎的目的地。

sentence_translations.sentence: Shooting Star is an organisation that helps school leavers by offering training followed by appropriate employment.
sentence_translations.translation: ‘流星’是一个帮助中学毕业生的组织，它提供培训并随后安排合适的工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: We at Shooting Star offer much more than a trip abroad.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们 Shooting Star 提供的远不止一次出国旅行。

sentence_translations.sentence: At Shooting Star you acquire skills that lead to interesting jobs both for your gap year and future holidays.
sentence_translations.translation: 在 Shooting Star，你能够获得技能，这些技能会为你带来在间隔年以及未来假期中从事有趣工作的机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: Magazines are full of 'Wanted' adverts for washing up in a restaurant.
sentence_translations.translation: 杂志上满是招聘餐厅洗碗工的‘诚聘’广告。

sentence_translations.sentence: Well, we don't do that- it's not our idea of excitement.
sentence_translations.translation: 嗯，我们不会那样做——这并非我们心目中的兴奋点。

sentence_translations.sentence: We offer school leavers the chance for outdoor adventure, to teach things like sailing and snowboarding.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们为离校生提供户外探险的机会，教授诸如帆船和滑雪等技能。

sentence_translations.sentence: No choice, really!
sentence_translations.translation: 真的别无选择！

sentence_translations.sentence: In your year out you train, travel and work; you can combine work with pleasure and reap the rewards.
sentence_translations.translation: 在间隔年里，你会接受培训、旅行和工作；你可以将工作与乐趣相结合，并从中获得回报。

sentence_translations.sentence: You could become an experienced yacht skipper or instructor and many people go on to spend their future holidays being paid to enjoy their favourite sport.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可能会成为一名经验丰富的游艇船长或教练，而许多人随后会在未来的假期中，通过享受他们最喜爱的运动来获得报酬。

sentence_translations.sentence: Australians and New Zealanders travel to Europe and North America in large numbers to gain overseas experience.
sentence_translations.translation: 大量澳大利亚人和新西兰人前往欧洲和北美以获取海外经历。

sentence_translations.sentence: Those who qualify with Shooting Star are very soon using their skills in jobs they could only dream about before, working outdoors and seeing more of the world.
sentence_translations.translation: 那些获得Shooting Star资格的人很快就能在他们以前只能梦想的工作中运用技能，在户外工作并见识更广阔的世界。

sentence_translations.sentence: Wherever you come from, a gap year with Shooting Star means professional training and international adventure.
sentence_translations.translation: 无论你来自哪里，与Shooting Star一起度过的间隔年意味着专业培训和国际冒险。

sentence_translations.sentence: Top tips for a successful gap year:
sentence_translations.translation: 成功间隔年的顶级建议：

sentence_translations.sentence: ☆ Design your gap year in outline before applying for a permanent job or a college place.
sentence_translations.translation: ☆ 在申请永久职位或大学入学之前，先大致规划你的间隔年。

sentence_translations.sentence: Human Resources officers or Admissions tutors will be impressed by a thought-out plan.
sentence_translations.translation: 人力资源官员或招生导师会对一个经过深思熟虑的计划印象深刻。

sentence_translations.sentence: ☆ What's more important to you - travel or work experience?
sentence_translations.translation: ☆ 对你来说，什么更重要——旅行还是工作经历？

sentence_translations.sentence: You can be flexible with travel plans but you must research job opportunities in advance.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以在旅行计划上灵活安排，但必须提前研究工作机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: Go to our website and click on Recruitment for ideas.
sentence_translations.translation: 访问我们的网站，点击“招聘”栏目获取想法。

sentence_translations.sentence: ☆ Who do you know who has taken a gap year before?
sentence_translations.translation: ☆ 你认识谁曾经度过间隔年吗？

sentence_translations.sentence: Shooting Star can put you in touch with someone who has just completed one.
sentence_translations.translation: “流星”机构可以帮你联系一位刚刚完成间隔年的人。

sentence_translations.sentence: ☆ Sort out the admin in plenty of time - air tickets, visas, insurance and medical matters such as vaccinations for some destinations.
sentence_translations.translation: 提前处理好行政事务——包括机票、签证、保险以及针对某些目的地所需的疫苗接种等医疗事项。

sentence_translations.sentence: These are your responsibility.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些是你的责任。

sentence_translations.sentence: ☆ Who is in charge of your affairs while you are away?
sentence_translations.translation: ☆ 当你不在的时候，谁负责处理你的事务？

sentence_translations.sentence: There will be forms to fill and letters to answer.
sentence_translations.translation: 会有表格需要填写，信件需要回复。

sentence_translations.sentence: ☆ Allow plenty of time to settle back home on your return - and don't be surprised if it takes some time to readjust to everyday life!
sentence_translations.translation: √ 请在回国后留出充足的时间让自己重新适应家庭生活——如果花一些时间才能重新适应日常生活，不必感到惊讶！

sentence_translations.sentence: Succeeding at Interviews
sentence_translations.translation: 面试中的成功之道

sentence_translations.sentence: Getting invited to an interview means you have passed the first hurdle - your application must have made a good impression.
sentence_translations.translation: 获得面试邀请意味着你已经通过了第一道难关——你的申请一定给人留下了良好的印象。

sentence_translations.sentence: Now you need to prepare yourself for the interview to make sure you make the most of this opportunity.
sentence_translations.translation: 现在你需要为面试做好准备，以确保你充分利用这一机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are a number of things you can do.
sentence_translations.translation: 你可以做许多事情来为此做准备。

sentence_translations.sentence: Firstly you can do some research.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，你可以做一些调研。

sentence_translations.sentence: Find out about the employer and the job, ask for an information pack or speak to people you know who work for the company.
sentence_translations.translation: 了解雇主和职位信息，索取相关资料包，或与你认识的公司员工交流。

sentence_translations.sentence: Try to plan for the interview by asking who will be interviewing you and whether there will be a test to take.
sentence_translations.translation: 尝试为面试做计划，询问谁将面试你以及是否有测试需要参加。

sentence_translations.sentence: Prepare for questions you might be asked.
sentence_translations.translation: 准备好你可能被问到的问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some common ones are the reason why you want the job, whether you have done this kind of work before, what your strengths and weaknesses are, and which leisure pursuits you enjoy.
sentence_translations.translation: 一些常见问题包括：你为什么想要这份工作，是否做过类似工作，你的优点和缺点是什么，以及你有哪些业余爱好。

sentence_translations.sentence: Another important point is never to run the risk of arriving late.
sentence_translations.translation: 另一个重要的一点是，永远不要冒险迟到。

sentence_translations.sentence: For example, consider making a 'dummy run in advance to see how long the journey will take.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，考虑提前进行一次模拟行程，以了解路途所需时间。

sentence_translations.sentence: Check out public transport or, if you are going by car, the nearest parking.
sentence_translations.translation: 查一下公共交通，或者如果你开车去，要找到最近的停车场。

sentence_translations.sentence: Aim to arrive about 10 minutes before the interview is due to start.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽量在面试预定开始时间前大约10分钟到达。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is also crucial to give plenty of thought to what you are going to wear.
sentence_translations.translation: 同样关键的是，要充分考虑你要穿什么。

sentence_translations.sentence: This will depend on the job you are going for.
sentence_translations.translation: 这将取决于你应聘的工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: There is no need to buy a new outfit, but aim to look neat and tidy.
sentence_translations.translation: 没有必要购买新套装，但务求看起来整洁得体。

sentence_translations.sentence: Remember, if you look good it will help you feel good.
sentence_translations.translation: 记住，如果你看起来不错，这会有助于你感觉良好。

sentence_translations.sentence: You need to make a good impression.
sentence_translations.translation: 你需要留下一个好印象。

sentence_translations.sentence: Interviews can vary from a relatively informal 'one-to-one' chat to a very formal panel situation.
sentence_translations.translation: 面试可能从相对非正式的“一对一”聊天，到非常正式的评审团面试，形式各不相同。

sentence_translations.sentence: Whatever the circumstances, you will give yourself an advantage by being friendly and polite, by making eye contact with the interviewer and by selling yourself by focusing on your strengths.
sentence_translations.translation: 无论在何种情况下，保持友好礼貌、与面试官进行眼神交流，并通过突出自身优势来推销自己，都会让你占据优势。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are also things you should avoid doing at your interview.
sentence_translations.translation: 在面试中也有一些你应该避免做的事情。

sentence_translations.sentence: First of all, don’t exaggerate.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，不要夸大其词。

sentence_translations.sentence: For example, if you don’t have the exact experience the employer is looking for, say so and explain you are willing to learn.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，如果你没有雇主正在寻找的特定经验，就如实说明并解释你愿意学习。

sentence_translations.sentence: Don’t simply give ‘yes’ and ‘no’ answers, but answer questions as fully as you can.
sentence_translations.translation: 不要仅仅给出‘是’或‘不是’的回答，而要尽可能完整地回答问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: And lastly don’t forget to ask questions as well as answering them.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后，不要忘了在回答问题的同时也提出问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: There are also things you should avoid doing at your interview.
sentence_translations.translation: 在面试中，你还需要避免做一些事情。

sentence_translations.sentence: First of all, don’t exaggerate.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，不要夸大其词。

sentence_translations.sentence: For example, if you don’t have the exact experience the employer is looking for, say so and explain you are willing to learn.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，如果你不具备雇主所要求的确切经验，就如实说明，并解释你愿意学习。

sentence_translations.sentence: Don’t simply give ‘yes’ and ‘no’ answers, but answer questions as fully as you can.
sentence_translations.translation: 不要只给出‘是’或‘不是’的回答，而是尽可能全面地回答问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: And lastly don’t forget to ask questions as well as answering them.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后，别忘了在回答问题的同时，也要提出问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: One final thing to remember: it is important to show good team spirit, that you possess good people skills and that you are friendly and approachable.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后一点要记住：展现出良好的团队精神、拥有出色的人际交往能力，以及为人友善且平易近人，这一点非常重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Finally, remember to be enthusiastic and show that you can be flexible.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后，请记住要保持热情，并展现出你可以灵活变通。

paragraphs.text: A

What do photography, dynamite, insulin and artificial sweetener have in common? Serendipity! These diverse discoveries, which have made our everyday living more convenient, were discovered partly by chance. However, Louis Pasteur noted the additional requirement involved in serendipity when he said, 'chance favours only the prepared mind'.
paragraphs.translation:
摄影、炸药、胰岛素和人造甜味剂有什么共同点？
偶然发现！
这些使我们的日常生活更加便捷的多样化发现，部分是偶然获得的。
然而，路易斯·巴斯德指出了偶然发现中的额外条件，他曾说：“机会只眷顾有准备的头脑。”
摄影、炸药、胰岛素和人造甜味剂有什么共同之处？
机缘巧合！
这些使我们的日常生活更加便利的多样化发现，部分是出于偶然。
然而，路易斯·巴斯德在指出‘机会只眷顾有准备的头脑’时，强调了机缘巧合所涉及的额外条件。

paragraphs.text: B

The discovery of modern photography provides an example of serendipity. In 1838, L.J.M. Daguerre was attempting to 'fix' images onto a copper photographic plate. After adding a silver coating to the plate and exposing it to iodine vapour, he found that the photographic image was improved but still very weak. Desperate after an investigation lasting several months, Daguerre placed a lightly exposed photographic plate in the cupboard in which laboratory chemicals such as alcohol and collodion were stored. To his amazement, when he removed the plate several days later, Daguerre found a strong image on its surface.
paragraphs.translation:
偶然发现！
机缘巧合！
现代摄影的发现提供了一个意外发现的例子。
1838年，L.J.M. 达盖尔试图将图像“固定”到铜质摄影感光板上。
在感光板上添加银涂层并暴露于碘蒸汽后，他发现摄影图像有所改善，但仍然非常模糊。
经过数月的研究，达盖尔感到绝望，于是将一块轻微曝光的摄影感光板放入了存放酒精和火棉胶等实验室化学品的柜子里。
令他惊讶的是，几天后当他取出感光板时，发现其表面出现了一幅清晰的图像。

paragraphs.text: C

This image had been created by chance. It was at this point that Louis Pasteur's 'additional requirement' came into play: Daguerre's training told him that one or more of the chemicals in the cupboard was responsible for intensifying the image. After a break of two weeks, Daguerre systematically placed new photographic plates in the cupboard, removing one chemical each day. Unpredictably, good photographic images were created even after all chemicals had been removed. Daguerre then noticed that some mercury had spilled onto the cupboard shelf, and he concluded that the mercury vapour must have improved the photographic result. From this discovery came the universal adoption of the silver-mercury process to develop photographs.
paragraphs.translation:
这张图像是偶然产生的。
正是在这个时候，路易·巴斯德的‘额外条件’发挥了作用：达盖尔的专业训练告诉他，橱柜中的一种或多种化学品是增强图像的原因。
在休息两周后，达盖尔系统地依次将新的照相底版放入橱柜，每天移除一种化学品。
出乎意料的是，即使移除了所有化学品，仍然产生了良好的照相图像。
达盖尔随后注意到一些水银洒在了橱柜的架子上，他推断水银蒸气一定改善了照相效果。
从这一发现开始，银-水银工艺被广泛采用来冲洗照片。

paragraphs.text: E

Daguerre's serendipitous research effort was rewarded, a year later, with a medal conferred by the French government. Many great scientists have benefited from serendipity, including Nobel Prize winners. In fact the scientist who established the Nobel Prize was himself blessed with serendipity. In 1861, the Nobel family built a factory in Stockholm to produce nitroglycerine, a colourless and highly explosive oil that had first been prepared by an Italian chemist fifteen years earlier. Nitroglycerine was known to be volatile and unpredictable, often exploding as a result of very small knocks. But the Nobel family believed that this new explosive could solve a major problem facing the Swedish State Railways - the need to dig channels and tunnels through mountains so that the developing railway system could expand.
paragraphs.translation:
偶然发现！
机缘巧合！
达盖尔偶然的研究努力在一年后得到了回报，他获得了法国政府颁发的奖章。
许多伟大的科学家都受益于意外发现，其中包括诺贝尔奖得主。
事实上，创立诺贝尔奖的科学家本人也受到了意外发现的眷顾。
1861年，诺贝尔家族在斯德哥尔摩建立了一家工厂来生产硝酸甘油，这是一种无色且极具爆炸性的油状物，由一位意大利化学家十五年前首次制备出来。
硝酸甘油以其易挥发和不可预测性而闻名，常常由于微小的撞击而发生爆炸。
但诺贝尔家族相信，这种新型炸药能够解决瑞典国家铁路面临的一个重大问题——即需要开凿穿越山脉的通道和隧道，以便不断发展的铁路系统得以扩展。

paragraphs.text: F

However, as turnover increased, so did the number of accidental explosions resulting from the use of nitroglycerine. Some people blamed the people who used the explosive more than the substance itself, because nitroglycerine had become popular for inappropriate purposes such as polishing the leather of shoes.
paragraphs.translation:
然而，随着使用量的增加，因使用硝化甘油而导致的意外爆炸数量也随之上升。
一些人更多地指责使用这种炸药的人，而非炸药本身，因为硝化甘油已因不当用途（例如用于擦亮皮鞋皮革）而变得流行。

paragraphs.text: G

At the age of thirty, Alfred Nobel made the first of his major inventions: an innovative blasting cap, a device designed to control the nitroglycerine explosion. Nobel was also determined to discover a way to make this explosive safer to manufacture, transport and use. Firstly, he experimented with adding chemicals to nitroglycerine, but because the chemicals required huge amounts of resources and energy to wash out, this process was considered to be impractical. He then tried to use fibrous material such as sawdust, charcoal or paper to stabilise the explosive,but these combustible materials tended to catch fire when placed near nitroglycerine. As an alternative, he added powdered brick dust to tame the explosive, as he knew that brick dust would not catch fire. However, the brick dust reduced the explosive power of the product, and so was also found to be unsatisfactory.
paragraphs.translation:
在三十岁时，阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔完成了他的第一项重大发明：一种创新的雷管，这是一种旨在控制硝化甘油爆炸的装置。
诺贝尔还决心找到一种方法，使这种炸药在生产、运输和使用中更加安全。
首先，他尝试向硝化甘油中添加化学物质，但由于这些化学物质需要大量资源和能量才能洗掉，这个过程被认为不实用。
然后他尝试使用诸如锯末、木炭或纸张等纤维材料来稳定炸药，但这些可燃材料在靠近硝化甘油时容易着火。

According to one version of how the eventual solution was found, a metal container of nitroglycerine sprang a leak, and some of the liquid soaked into packaging material that lay around the container. Nobel immediately set to work to examine the connection between the two materials and found that when the packaging material was mixed with nitroglycerine it could be pressed into a compact solid. This solid retained the explosive power of the liquid, but was entirely safe and reliable because it would not ignite until set off by a blasting cap.

诺贝尔立即着手研究这两种材料之间的联系，并发现当包装材料与硝化甘油混合时，可以被压制成一种紧实的固体。

As a scientist who had worked systematically towards a solution for a number of years, Nobel immediately understood the importance of this discovery. sentence_translations.sentence: Desperate after an investigation lasting several months, Daguerre placed a lightly exposed photographic plate in the cupboard in which laboratory chemicals such as alcohol and collodion were stored.
sentence_translations.translation: 经过数月的研究，达盖尔感到绝望，于是将一块轻微曝光的摄影感光板放入了存放酒精和火棉胶等实验室化学品的柜子里。

sentence_translations.sentence: To his amazement, when he removed the plate several days later, Daguerre found a strong image on its surface.
sentence_translations.translation: 令他惊讶的是，几天后当他取出感光板时，发现其表面出现了一幅清晰的图像。

sentence_translations.sentence: This image had been created by chance.
sentence_translations.translation: 这张图像是偶然产生的。

sentence_translations.sentence: It was at this point that Louis Pasteur's 'additional requirement' came into play: Daguerre's training told him that one or more of the chemicals in the cupboard was responsible for intensifying the image.
sentence_translations.translation: 正是在这个时候，路易·巴斯德的‘额外条件’发挥了作用：达盖尔的专业训练告诉他，橱柜中的一种或多种化学品是增强图像的原因。

sentence_translations.sentence: After a break of two weeks, Daguerre systematically placed new photographic plates in the cupboard, removing one chemical each day.
sentence_translations.translation: 在休息两周后，达盖尔系统地依次将新的照相底版放入橱柜，每天移除一种化学品。

sentence_translations.sentence: Unpredictably, good photographic images were created even after all chemicals had been removed.
sentence_translations.translation: 出乎意料的是，即使移除了所有化学品，仍然产生了良好的照相图像。

sentence_translations.sentence: Daguerre then noticed that some mercury had spilled onto the cupboard shelf, and he concluded that the mercury vapour must have improved the photographic result.
sentence_translations.translation: 达盖尔随后注意到一些水银洒在了橱柜的架子上，他推断水银蒸气一定改善了照相效果。

sentence_translations.sentence: From this discovery came the universal adoption of the silver-mercury process to develop photographs.
sentence_translations.translation: 从这一发现开始，银-水银工艺被广泛采用来冲洗照片。

sentence_translations.sentence: Daguerre's serendipitous research effort was rewarded, a year later, with a medal conferred by the French government.
sentence_translations.translation: 达盖尔偶然的研究努力在一年后得到了回报，他获得了法国政府颁发的奖章。

sentence_translations.sentence: Many great scientists have benefited from serendipity, including Nobel Prize winners.
sentence_translations.translation: 许多伟大的科学家都受益于意外发现，其中包括诺贝尔奖得主。

sentence_translations.sentence: In fact the scientist who established the Nobel Prize was himself blessed with serendipity.
sentence_translations.translation: 事实上，创立诺贝尔奖的科学家本人也受到了意外发现的眷顾。

sentence_translations.sentence: In 1861, the Nobel family built a factory in Stockholm to produce nitroglycerine, a colourless and highly explosive oil that had first been prepared by an Italian chemist fifteen years earlier.
sentence_translations.translation: 1861年，诺贝尔家族在斯德哥尔摩建立了一家工厂来生产硝酸甘油，这是一种无色且极具爆炸性的油状物，由一位意大利化学家十五年前首次制备出来。

sentence_translations.sentence: Nitroglycerine was known to be volatile and unpredictable, often exploding as a result of very small knocks.
sentence_translations.translation: 硝酸甘油以其易挥发和不可预测性而闻名，常常由于微小的撞击而发生爆炸。

sentence_translations.sentence: But the Nobel family believed that this new explosive could solve a major problem facing the Swedish State Railways - the need to dig channels and tunnels through mountains so that the developing railway system could expand.
sentence_translations.translation: 但诺贝尔家族相信，这种新型炸药能够解决瑞典国家铁路面临的一个重大问题——即需要开凿穿越山脉的通道和隧道，以便不断发展的铁路系统得以扩展。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, as turnover increased, so did the number of accidental explosions resulting from the use of nitroglycerine.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，随着使用量的增加，因使用硝化甘油而导致的意外爆炸数量也随之上升。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some people blamed the people who used the explosive more than the substance itself, because nitroglycerine had become popular for inappropriate purposes such as polishing the leather of shoes.
sentence_translations.translation: 一些人更多地指责使用这种炸药的人，而非炸药本身，因为硝化甘油已因不当用途（例如用于擦亮皮鞋皮革）而变得流行。

sentence_translations.sentence: At the age of thirty, Alfred Nobel made the first of his major inventions: an innovative blasting cap, a device designed to control the nitroglycerine explosion.
sentence_translations.translation: 在三十岁时，阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔完成了他的第一项重大发明：一种创新的雷管，这是一种旨在控制硝化甘油爆炸的装置。

sentence_translations.sentence: Nobel was also determined to discover a way to make this explosive safer to manufacture, transport and use.
sentence_translations.translation: 诺贝尔还决心找到一种方法，使这种炸药在生产、运输和使用中更加安全。

sentence_translations.sentence: Firstly, he experimented with adding chemicals to nitroglycerine, but because the chemicals required huge amounts of resources and energy to wash out, this process was considered to be impractical.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，他尝试向硝化甘油中添加化学物质，但由于这些化学物质需要大量资源和能量才能洗掉，这个过程被认为不实用。

sentence_translations.sentence: He then tried to use fibrous material such as sawdust, charcoal or paper to stabilise the explosive, but these combustible materials tended to catch fire when placed near nitroglycerine.
sentence_translations.translation: 然后他尝试使用诸如锯末、木炭或纸张等纤维材料来稳定炸药，但这些可燃材料在靠近硝化甘油时容易着火。

sentence_translations.sentence: As an alternative, he added powdered brick dust to tame the explosive, as he knew that brick dust would not catch fire.
sentence_translations.translation: 作为替代方案，他添加了砖粉来抑制炸药，因为他知道砖粉不会着火。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, the brick dust reduced the explosive power of the product, and so was also found to be unsatisfactory.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，砖粉降低了产品的爆炸威力，因此也被认为不令人满意。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, the brick dust reduced the explosive power of the product, and so was also found to be unsatisfactory.

sentence_translations.sentence: According to one version of how the eventual solution was found, a metal container of nitroglycerine sprang a leak, and some of the liquid soaked into packaging material that lay around the container.
sentence_translations.translation: 根据一种关于最终解决方案如何被发现的描述，一个装有硝化甘油的金属容器出现了泄漏，部分液体渗入了容器周围的包装材料中。

sentence_translations.sentence: Nobel immediately set to work to examine the connection between the two materials and found that when the packaging material was mixed with nitroglycerine it could be pressed into a compact solid.
sentence_translations.translation: 诺贝尔立即着手研究这两种材料之间的联系，并发现当包装材料与硝化甘油混合时，可以被压制成一种紧实的固体。

sentence_translations.sentence: This solid retained the explosive power of the liquid, but was entirely safe and reliable because it would not ignite until set off by a blasting cap.
sentence_translations.translation: 这种固体保留了液体的爆炸威力，但完全安全可靠，因为只有在引爆雷管的触发下才会点燃。

sentence_translations.sentence: As a scientist who had worked systematically towards a solution for a number of years, Nobel immediately understood the importance of this discovery.
sentence_translations.translation: 作为一名多年来系统性地致力于寻找解决方案的科学家，诺贝尔立刻意识到了这一发现的重要性。

sentence_translations.sentence: But the discovery had only come about because of his perseverance.
sentence_translations.translation: 但这一发现之所以能够实现，仅仅是因为他的坚持不懈。

sentence_translations.sentence: Through Nobel's clear vision, systematic research and his quick grasp of the significance of his discovery, he set himself apart from the many scientists who were not 'fortunate' enough to create new products that would make them famous.
sentence_translations.translation: 凭借诺贝尔清晰的远见、系统的研究以及他迅速领悟到其发现重要性的能力，他使自己与众多‘不够幸运’、未能创造出能让自己声名远扬的新产品的科学家区分开来。

sentence_translations.sentence: Alfred Nobel, a lifelong pacifist, hoped that his explosive would be a powerful deterrent to warfare.
sentence_translations.translation: 阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔，一位终身的和平主义者，希望他的炸药能成为战争强有力的威慑力量。

sentence_translations.sentence: Nobel sought to achieve permanent worldwide peace.
sentence_translations.translation: 诺贝尔致力于实现持久的世界和平。

sentence_translations.sentence: In setting up the Nobel Foundation and the Nobel Peace Prizes, he hoped to accomplish what he had not been able to do during his lifetime: to encourage research and activities that would bestow the 'greatest benefit to mankind', especially peace and fraternity between nations.
sentence_translations.translation: 通过设立诺贝尔基金会和诺贝尔和平奖，他希望能够实现他一生未能完成的目标：鼓励那些能带来'人类最大福祉'的研究与活动，尤其是国家之间的和平与友爱。

sentence_translations.sentence: His vision was of a peaceful world.
